source_caption:
🎬 ParaNorman (2012)

ParaNorman follows Norman Babcock, an unusual 11-year-old boy living in the small town of Blithe Hollow who possesses an extraordinary ability to see and communicate with ghosts. While most people around him believe he is strange, including his classmates and family, Norman finds comfort in the supernatural world that only he can experience. His life takes a dramatic turn when he discovers that his town is threatened by an ancient witch’s curse capable of bringing the dead back to life. With terrifying zombies beginning to rise and panic spreading throughout the community, Norman realizes that he may be the only person capable of stopping the supernatural disaster. Joined by an unlikely group of companions, including his loyal friend Neil, his older sister Courtney, and several unexpected allies, Norman embarks on a dangerous adventure filled with mysterious clues, frightening encounters, and hilarious misunderstandings. As he investigates the town’s dark history, he uncovers a heartbreaking truth behind the curse that challenges everything the townspeople believe about their past. Rather than relying on violence or fear, Norman discovers that understanding, empathy, and compassion may be the keys to saving everyone. Combining stunning stop-motion animation, spooky humor, emotional storytelling, and unforgettable characters, the film explores bullying, friendship, courage, acceptance, prejudice, and the importance of treating others with kindness.

🎭 Genre: Animation • Adventure • Comedy • Fantasy • Horror

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 32m • PG

🎥 Directors: Sam Fell & Chris Butler

source_details.synopsis: ParaNorman is a 2012 American independent stop-motion animated comedy horror film produced by Laika. Directed by Sam Fell and Chris Butler and written by Butler, the film stars the voices of Kodi Smit-McPhee, Jodelle Ferland, Bernard Hill, Tucker Albrizzi, Anna Kendrick, Casey Affleck, Christopher Mintz-Plasse, Leslie Mann, Jeff Garlin, Elaine Stritch, and John Goodman. It is the first stop-motion film to use a 3D color printer to create character faces. In the film, Norman Babcock (Smit-McPhee), a young boy who can communicate with ghosts, is given the task of ending a 300-year-old witch's curse on his Massachusetts town.
